criteria.material: Quality and durability of the fabric. Natural, organic or premium fibres (linen, merino, organic cotton, hemp, cashmere) score high; thin synthetics or unknown materials score low.
criteria.versatility: How many outfits and occasions it works for. Neutral colours and classic cuts score high; loud one-off pieces score low.
criteria.trend: How current it feels for menswear right now. Relaxed fits, textured knits, workwear and earth tones score high; dated styles score low.
criteria.value: Price relative to the material and construction. A fair price for the quality scores high; an expensive basic scores low. Sale prices count.
